skill.name: web-search
skill.description: Run Tavily and Exa web search, answer, and extraction apps through the inference.sh belt CLI.
skill.summary: Search the web and extract page content with Tavily and Exa through belt.
skill.author: 101-skills

security_audit.summary: The skill has legitimate web search and extraction behavior, but several examples execute the external belt CLI and send queries or URLs to providers. Most markdown backtick and hardcoded URL findings are documentation noise, while the broad Bash(belt *) allowlist is a real scope concern.

remediation.suggestion: Replace Bash(belt *) with the narrowest command patterns needed for Tavily and Exa search, answer, and extraction examples.
Warn users that queries, URLs, extracted pages, and LLM prompts may be sent to Tavily, Exa, OpenRouter, and inference.sh.
Pin recommended skill or CLI installation commands to trusted versions or references, and document how users can verify them.

content.value_statement: Research tasks often need current web results and clean page content. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code guided access to Tavily and Exa through belt.
actual_capabilities: Runs Tavily Search Assistant for web queries with answers and sources.
Runs Tavily Extract to retrieve clean content from supplied URLs.
Runs Exa Search for relevant web links with context.
Runs Exa Answer for direct factual answers.
Runs Exa Extract to analyze a supplied web page.
Shows workflows that combine search or extraction with LLM summarization.
limitations: Requires the inference.sh belt CLI and any required account setup.
Sends queries, URLs, and extracted content to external providers.
Result quality depends on Tavily, Exa, and provider availability.
Does not verify source accuracy beyond returned search results.

use_cases.title: Research Current Topics
use_cases.description: Collect recent links, source summaries, and direct answers before writing or planning work.

use_cases.title: Prepare RAG Inputs
use_cases.description: Extract readable page content from selected URLs for retrieval pipelines or knowledge workflows.

use_cases.title: Check Claims With Sources
use_cases.description: Search for supporting pages and compare returned evidence before accepting a factual claim.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Topic Search
prompt_templates.prompt: Search the web for recent information about renewable energy storage. Return the main points and source links.

prompt_templates.title: Extract One Article
prompt_templates.prompt: Extract the main content from this article URL, then summarize the claims, evidence, and publication context.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Search Providers
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Tavily and Exa to research vector databases for enterprise search. Compare the strongest sources and note disagreements.

prompt_templates.title: Build Research Brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Research the latest model evaluation methods, extract key sources, and produce a brief with trends, risks, and citations.

output_examples.input: Find recent information about AI agent evaluation methods.
output_examples.output: A concise research summary with source links, recurring themes, and notes about which claims need stronger evidence.

output_examples.input: Extract and summarize a long article about battery recycling.
output_examples.output: A readable article summary with key facts, named organizations, dates, and unresolved questions for follow-up research.

output_examples.input: Compare Tavily and Exa results for a technical market question.
output_examples.output: A side-by-side source review that highlights overlapping results, unique findings, and confidence levels.

best_practices: Review URLs before extraction and avoid private or sensitive pages.
Ask for source links and dates when researching current topics.
Cross-check important claims with more than one returned source.
anti_patterns: Do not send secrets, private documents, or customer data to web providers.
Do not treat generated answers as verified facts without reading sources.
Do not use broad searches when a specific query or URL is available.

faq.question: What services does this skill use?
faq.answer: It documents Tavily and Exa search and extraction apps through the inference.sh belt CLI.

faq.question: Does it require setup?
faq.answer: Yes. You need the belt CLI and any provider access required by inference.sh.

faq.question: Can it browse any website?
faq.answer: It can request supported provider extraction for supplied URLs, but site access and provider limits still apply.

faq.question: Can it provide citations?
faq.answer: Search responses can include source links, but users should verify important claims directly.

faq.question: Is it safe for private data?
faq.answer: No. Treat queries, URLs, and extracted content as data sent to external services.

faq.question: Can it work with Claude Code and Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.
